scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run deploy:dry
scripts.test: vitest run && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s containers/game -p '*_test.py'
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit
scripts.release:worker:candidate: node scripts/assert-clean.mjs && npm run check && node scripts/release-worker.mjs candidate
scripts.release:containers: node scripts/assert-clean.mjs && npm run check && wrangler deploy --containers-rollout=gradual
